ledger.name: The Ledger
ledger.description: Counts things: rooms, bells, dates, the number of steps. It would rather be wrong than vague.

boundary.name: The Boundary
boundary.description: Where things are and how big they are. Distances, gaps, whether something fits. It speaks up when a space does not close.

echo.name: Echo
echo.description: The part of you that remembers. Fast, generous, and often wrong about what it recognises.

onlooker.name: The Onlooker
onlooker.description: Watches people: tone, faces, what someone does with their hands. Certain about other people's reasons, with no way to check them.
